R 是你每一笔交易愿意亏的钱。先定 1R，再用止损的远近决定买多少：止损近就多买: R is the money you are willing to lose on each trade. Set 1R first, then let the stop distance decide how much to buy: a close stop means more shares, a far stop means fewer. That way every stopped trade loses the same 1R.
